mechanism: Both agents are used in postmenopausal breast cancer; zoledronic acid increases risk of osteonecrosis of jaw and atypical fractures, while anastrozole causes bone loss through aromatase inhibition, compounding skeletal complications.
action: Monitor bone health closely with periodic DEXA scans, ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D supplementation, maintain dental hygiene, and assess fracture risk regularly; consider drug-specific timing strategies if clinically appropriate.
